name: Power Of The Mind
overview: Scripture reveals the transformative power of the mind when it is renewed and focused on God’s truth rather than worldly patterns. Believers are called to set their minds on things above and to be transformed by the renewing of their minds, enabling them to discern and live according to the perfect will of God. This renewal is closely connected to walking in the Spirit, steadfast devotion to apostolic teaching and prayer, and resisting a hardened, rebellious heart. Contentment and trust in God's faithful presence further guard the mind against covetousness and worldly influences.
